adjudication.rationale: In new `app/assets/javascripts/embed.js`, the message handler uses `if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) { return; }`, which is a substring/prefix match rather than an exact origin comparison. If `discourseUrl` is e.g. `http://forum.example.com/`, an attacker origin `http://forum.example.co` would pass because it is a prefix substring. After passing that check, `e.data.height` is used directly to set `iframe.height` with no numeric/range validation, allowing arbitrary resizing by any window that can satisfy the weak origin check. This is a verifiable security/correctness issue introduced by the diff.
